naming_rules.primary_unit: 左右それぞれの1動作を1セットとする。4と2以外の組合せ、左右同時の2xも含む。
naming_rules.user_term_2: 短い側の動作の総称として扱う。実行データでは2と2x、保持と投げを区別する。
naming_rules.column: 縦に動く4側を基準にする空間上の役割。位置と担当する手は別々に記録し、4や4xという記号だけで軌道を決めない。
naming_rules.x: 投げ手と受け手の交替。球の水平移動の有無や腕のクロスとは独立。
naming_rules.asterisk: Henry Fisherの原表記を保持し、出典名をセットで表示する。
naming_rules.laterality: L/Rは実演者本人の左手/右手。画面の左右と分離する。
naming_rules.passing_scope: 本人の左右の手の受け渡しのみ。
naming_rules.sequence_name: 自由な表示名と、球数B／動きの周期S／球識別の周期C／内容IDによる構成名を分離。正確な同一性はSYNC1構造コードで比較。

double_box_source_matrix.verification_scope: Seventeen sampled HD frames support successive 4x then self 4 by one hand, followed by its reflection, with low 2x transfers. Existing Double Box supplies this four-set structure. Its cross-hand 4x moves laterally, unlike the central vertical 4x in Extended Box. Exact timing, depth and elbow angles remain unverified.

23 paused HD frames with seek time and ready state checked before and after capture. 4x accompanies high-to-low 2x; self 4 accompanies low-to-low 2x. One hand performs 4x then self 4 before roles switch. White self 4 leaves the left hand around 0.55-0.60s and returns to left near 1.10s; white crosses low to the right at 1.50-1.65s and high-to-low back to the left around 2.00-2.10s. The high release holds the ball from below/behind while sending it inward; use explicit underhand release support, not the default shuffle claw bias. Model set time is 0.41s; source interval is approximately 0.50s. Exact source fidelity remains unverified.

22 paused HD frames with seek time and ready state checked before and after capture. 4x accompanies low-to-low 2x; self 4 accompanies high-to-low 2x. One hand performs 4x then self 4 before roles switch. White crosses high from left to right around 0.90-1.45s; the right hand releases its red high-to-low 2x around 1.35s before catching white. White next crosses high from right around 1.80s. The red high-to-low release at 1.30-1.35s uses support from below/behind; use explicit underhand release support, with all catches underhand. Model set time is 0.41s; source interval is approximately 0.45s. Exact source fidelity remains unverified.

24 paused HD frames with seek time and ready state checked before and after capture. 4x accompanies low-to-low 2x; self 4 accompanies low-to-high 2x. Each high hand throws 4x then self 4 before roles switch. White transfers from right low around 0.55s to left high around 0.70s, then transfers low from left around 1.05s to right; the right hand throws white as self 4 around 1.50s. The high catch approaches the ascending ball. The frontal images do not resolve the precise palm pitch; retain automatic catch grip and do not claim exact grip fidelity. Model time is 0.41s/set versus approximately 0.45-0.50s in the source.

23 paused HD frames with seek time and ready state checked before and after capture. Both the 4x set and self-4 set use low-to-high 2x; high hands repeat for two sets before switching. White returns to the left from self 4 around 1.00s, transfers low-to-high to the right around 1.35-1.50s, and transfers low-to-high back to the left around 1.90-2.05s. Capture verifies high receiving-hand positions. Exact palm pitch and continuous wrist rotation are not determined; the model retains automatic grip. Model time is 0.41s/set versus approximately 0.45-0.50s in the source.

Twenty-three HD frames, with paused ready-state and seek time checked before and after capture, support 4x followed by self 4 in each hand. Low 2x accompanies 4x; high 2x accompanies self 4. White is released from left around 0.65s, returns to left around 1.2s and transfers high to right around 1.5-1.6s. Exact dimensions, depth and timing are not reconstructed. The model retains 0.41 seconds per set; the observed interval is approximately 0.45 seconds.

double_box_source_matrix.implementation_scope: Four sets alternate 4x and self 4 with high-throw hands right/right/left/left. Every short 2x is an underarm release to an opposite-hand claw catch. Low catches remain near centre rather than the standalone fixed-role source catch. Exact timing, depth and elbow fidelity and current simulator UI are unverified.

implementation_notes.finding: 37プリセット、担当・時刻・重力飛行・保持と空手の接続。
四段階、位置・経路・手の向きの独立定義。
付属VRMで検査した動作の位置と運び。
両腕の周期経路、腕と球の間隔、肘の移動の連続性。
骨長を保つIK、手の方向と前腕のひねり。

review_boundary: 2つのPDFの分類と追加指摘を反映。実装37種と左右反転、基本16組合せを付属VRMの骨格で検査。全出典の実演、全UA名称、Double Box全81種の一致は未検証。In-line 3は常に同じ縦線上に3球を保つ。2xを一番上に置く形は派生候補。

phase_contract.connection_rule: 隣接する部品は球の担当と両手の位置、速度、腕の上下関係が連続するときに接続する。逆向きに見える名称だけで逆再生しない。
phase_contract.executable_parameters: 各位相の時刻、座標、姿勢は実演照合後に追加する。

suggested_build_sequence.purpose: 通常コラムと通常2xの同時リリース、3球の連続性を確認する。
コラムを基準に2側の上/下の関係と両手の移動を比較する。
空間上のコラムと解剖学的な左右の手を分離し、交差の切替を扱う。
縦の受け渡しと、そのために受ける手が移動する区間を扱う。
9分類のUA派生も実演に照合して加え、接続できる部品を増やす。

motion_stages: 次の投げる位置への移動

stage_rules.flight: 重力のある放物線。通過点は放物線上の制約とし、途中で軌道を曲げない。
stage_rules.carry: 保持中の球と空の手の戻りを分離。次の投げ位置は同じ球の次のリリース。
stage_rules.underarm: 投げと捕りを独立指定。
stage_rules.crossed: 左上固定、右上固定、左右交代。
stage_rules.inline: 保持中・飛行中とも3球を常に同じ縦線上に置く。上下順を保ち、空の手だけが列の外を回る。
stage_rules.elbow: 体側の下がった位置を優先。胴体交差と肘・手首の無理な向きを禁止し、候補・補間・再生で確認。不成立の配置は直前の動作へ戻す。
stage_rules.hand: 投げは送り出す方向、捕りは球が来る方向。手首の折れと回転の不連続を避ける。
